items.title: 5.13.2 Uses of liquid crystals in daily life

source_refs.note: Topic 5.13.2, printed pages 112-113, as printed: the three headed uses and Quick Check 5.9. The chapter exercise (pages 113-116) is not reproduced.

blocks.text: The main application area of liquid crystals is in electro-optic devices. These are electrically controlled devices that modulate light in a desired way. Liquid crystals have many uses in daily life.
